{"notes": "VISIT 6 (left 8:00). Nobody spoke and I saw no one's hands on the table, so no new evidence about any individual. I still don't know who placed which domino. I did not see the push or the result.

TABLE: Fish outline complete and connected from START, both tail tips reached. The 3 pale, disconnected dominoes near (23-24, 8.3-9) are still beside the upper tail line at the crossing. No one has owned or removed them. They may not break the chain, but I can't tell. Check after the push whether they mattered.

SOFIA: No new observations. Earlier: strong concept, plan and work split, calm at 5:45. Gap: her 2:30 tail inspection either didn't happen or missed the strays. Ask what she checked.

OMAR: No new observations. Clean handoff earlier. He offered at 2:30 to fix an off-side domino, but the strays remain and he said nothing. Ask whether those were the dominoes he meant and why he didn't follow through.

HANA: No new observations. Only one short 'hands off, here we go' from her. Belly section looks connected and clean, so her output is solid. Ask directly about blockers and her role; don't read quiet as disengaged.

JACK: No new observations. Positive, team-minded, credited the team. He took on tilt and gap checking, but I never saw it and the strays survived. Ask what he actually checked. Execution evidence thin.

REVIEW QUESTIONS: Who saw the strays? Why left? Who did the checking? Rate on what I saw and what they tell me. Impact and collaboration are better supported than execution and ownership. Leadership evidence limited mostly to Sofia."}
